title: E-Motion
lyrics:
[00:00.000] 作词 : Margaret Comes/Douglas Saltzman
[00:01.000] 作曲 : Margaret Comes/Douglas Saltzman
[00:18.064]It hurts the face to smile when I don't feel light
[00:32.008]But it's more comfortable to curl my lips to yours
[00:46.255]But what is the use of being alive if you don't
[01:00.410]Show that emotion you're covering up?
[01:13.123]Show that emotion you're covering up
[01:54.156]But I want the moon to rise
[02:00.619]To become magnified
[02:06.692]To slow down a lifeline
[02:13.189]Examine the inside
[02:19.524]What is the use of being alive if you don't
[02:32.097]Show that emotion you're covering up?
[02:44.693]Show that emotion you're covering up
[03:38.482]Can I stay here a little bit longer?
[03:44.580]The window is down, the sun will come out
[03:49.744]On the street, a petrichor armor
[03:55.835]I inhaled the pit of your arm
[04:00.964]Can I stay here?
[04:07.001]God damn, tell me anything you've thought
[04:12.255]Your eyes light up when you sing to me
[04:20.488]Will you sing me anything?
[04:26.192]Anything you want
[04:31.625]Will you sing me anything?
[04:37.797]Anything you want
[04:43.349]Will you sing me anything, anything you want?
